patterns.note: Full-width sections with content centered and constrained to a maximum width, often using a grid for feature presentation (e.g., 3-column for stats, 2-column for features with images).
Prominent, oversized display headings in a bold sans-serif font, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text and occasional uppercase labels for subheadings.
A vibrant gradient purple palette dominates, used for backgrounds and accents, complemented by white and light grey sections for contrast. A bright teal/aqua is used for primary CTAs.
Sections reveal elements (text, cards, images) with a subtle fade-in and slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
The hero section features a parallax effect where a large app screenshot moves at a different speed than the background, creating depth.
The primary navigation bar transitions from transparent over the hero to a solid purple background with a subtle shadow and remains sticky at the top of the viewport after scrolling.
Repeated use of large, illustrative app screenshots or abstract UI elements integrated into feature sections, often paired with descriptive text.

technique_notes: Visual sections are defined by alternating background colors and gradients, with content centered within a maximum width.

Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal content: elements within sections (text, images, cards) fade in and slide up from the bottom as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated with a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger.
The hero section employs a parallax scrolling effect where a large, illustrative app screenshot moves vertically at a slower rate than the background, creating a sense of depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display headings (~3-4x body text) with clear visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible body text and occasional uppercase sub-labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle. Buttons, cards, and UI elements have a consistent, slightly rounded corner radius (e.g., 8-12px).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy. Generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable spacing within content blocks, creating a breathable layout.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a rich, gradient purple color palette combined with large, illustrative app screenshots that often feature subtle parallax or reveal animations. This creates a strong, product-centric visual identity that feels both modern and sophisticated, moving beyond typical marketing site templates.
